techniques: dynamic ntdll API resolution via GetModuleHandleA and GetProcAddress
current-process targeting via GetCurrentProcessId and NtOpenProcess

encryption_details.algorithm: RC4 (standard KSA and PRGA), applied to a 48-byte embedded shellcode blob
encryption_details.key_storage: Hard-coded 16-byte raw global array g_rc4_key in .rdata at RVA 0x5000 (VA 0x140005000); ciphertext is g_encrypted_shellcode in .data at RVA 0x4000

anti_analysis: Calls dynamically resolved NtQueryInformationProcess with information class 7 (ProcessDebugPort) against the current process and aborts the injection path when the returned 32-bit debug-port value is 0xFFFFFFFF

injection_details.method: Native APC self-injection using NtQueueApcThread followed by NtAlertResumeThread
injection_details.target_discovery: Obtains its PID with GetCurrentProcessId, opens itself with NtOpenProcess (desired access 0x42A), snapshots all threads with CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPTHREAD), selects a THREADENTRY32 whose th32OwnerProcessID matches the current PID, and opens it with OpenThread access 0x12
injection_details.thread_preparation: Suspends the selected existing thread with SuspendThread
injection_details.payload: 48-byte embedded shellcode copied to the stack and decrypted in place with RC4
injection_details.payload_write: NtAllocateVirtualMemory in the opened process with MEM_RESERVE|MEM_COMMIT (0x3000) and PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE (0x40), then NtWriteVirtualMemory copies the decrypted 48-byte payload
injection_details.execution: NtQueueApcThread queues the allocated base as the APC routine (Arg1 is also the allocated base; Arg2 and Arg3 are zero), then NtAlertResumeThread alerts and resumes the suspended thread
injection_details.cleanup: Resolves and calls NtClose on the thread and process handles
